adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `createEvent` now selects the target calendar via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and falls back to `"primary"` when no match is found. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts#createAllCalendarEvents`, when a destination calendar entry has no `credentialId`, it enters the per-integration fallback loop (`destinationCalendarCredentials.map(...)`) and calls `createEvent(c, event)` without associating the destination entry’s `externalId` to the credential. Since the destination calendar object may still carry an `externalId` but has `credentialId: null/undefined`, Google’s `find` won’t match and will insert into `primary`, losing the user-selected destination calendar for that case.
